findings: Verdict: the lane's claims hold. I checked all six points and none of them blocks an admin merge. The findings below are non-blocking.

(1) Scope check passed. `git diff --name-only 452fd46...HEAD` lists 11 files, all owned: scripts/take_intake.py, tests/test_take_intake.py, just/take.just, .agents/skills/take-intake/SKILL.md, program/tool-drafts/take_intake.json, docs/spec/sprints/TAKE_INTAKE_S3.md, and 5 files matching docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/take_intake-*.json. There are no root-owned or foreign edits. The frozen spec (72a224a to HEAD) only gained 44 lines in a new section 14; sections 1-13 are unchanged. The working tree is clean.

(2) Boundary check passed. Nothing was written to the main checkout's artifacts/runs; its newest run is from Oct 6, and artifacts/take-intake does not exist. The worktree's artifacts/ holds only s2/. The e2e and dev runs used copied roots under artifacts/s2/take_intake/e2e-*/root. The code never references Documents or Desktop. There are no edits to program/tools.json, scripts/tool_api.py or just/workflow.just. The code is stdlib only: no model downloads and no daemons. Child processes run in their own session, are waited on, and are SIGKILLed only on a deadline (stop_owned_child, take_intake.py ~889-911). The dev-smoke SIGKILLs targeted the lane's own processes and are receipted in take_intake-handoff.json.

(4) Test rerun reproduced the claimed counts. I ran FFMPEG/FFPROBE=nix ffmpeg-headless-8.1.2 with PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_take_intake -v. Result: 'Ran 34 tests in 92.840s', 'OK (skipped=1)', exit 0, 33 ok. The skipped test is EndToEndTests.test_sealed_take_run (e2e_gated_set_TAKE_INTAKE_E2E_1). The lane claimed 119.451 s and the receipt says 139.25 s; only the timing differs. The shasum of scripts/take_intake.py (0997082e...) and tests/test_take_intake.py (e55bd6dc...) match the receipts.

(4) The tests exercise the claimed behaviour. They cover plan determinism (3 byte-identical plan stdouts, and the same bytes at two paths), refusals with filesystem snapshots, resume scenarios a-e, demo binding with 0, 1 and 2 candidates, packet keys and unknowns, the V6 draft with planted negative controls, and the absence of host paths. Caveat: all 5 resume tests use stub stages. The real demo/run_demo --resume path is exercised only by the untracked dev smokes described in the handoff, not by any unit test.

(4) The tracked-path refusal test (tests/test_take_intake.py ~318-331) only covers an untracked, unignored file in a fresh git repo, plus the ignored case being accepted. No test covers an actually tracked file that git has staged or committed.

(6) Arithmetic reproduced from the retained state in artifacts/s2/take_intake/e2e-20261007T154518Z/root/artifacts/take-intake/*/*/intake.json. Stage statuses: completed 3, abstained 3+1=4, failed 2, skipped 1, total 10, intake status 'partial'. Sealed fixture sha256 = 34d53399...b580, matching the preregistration. 12.012 s x 24000/1001 fps = 288.0 frames, matching 288/288. -18 - (-19.96) = 1.96 LU, matching target_offset 1.96. Phrase start 9.696 = 7.0 + 4 x 0.674. 32.703 Hz = C1. The committed take_intake-e2e.json is byte-identical (cmp) to the retained e2e-results.json, so the receipt was not hand-edited.

(5) The 32 Hz doctrine is respected. In the e2e run manifest and export outcome I found no highpass, bandreject, anequalizer or lowpass filters, only afftdn, which matches the packet guard's 0 violations across 14 graphs. The orchestrator adds no filter. All 23 UNKNOWNS fields are present with reasons. Every stage has a hard timeout (demo has the largest at 7800 s; the rest are 180-1260 s). git and ffprobe calls are bounded at 20 s and 60 s. FULLER is already DEFAULT_PROFILE on main (scripts/run_demo.py:36), and the lane only passes it explicitly, so nothing is adopted.

(3) Claims are classed correctly. The e2e receipt, handoff and skill keep the synthetic run separate from real-take accuracy and carry an explicit interpretation_boundary. No verdict is given on note correctness or missed notes. Timing direction is withheld_uncalibrated.

(3) The phrase_timing result is empty. The e2e receipt scores phrase_timing as 'completed' and 'as_predicted', but it measured 0 of 0 phrases: phrases.json proposed 0 review spans, although the fixture contains 2 phrases by construction. The completed status has a zero denominator. The packet reports it, but the receipt and handoff should mark it plainly as 0/0 rather than an as-predicted completion.

(3) The preregistration predicted that flags_triage and marked_video would complete. Yet its own development_runs_before_sealing note records that the dev smoke already failed with triage_window_basis_unavailable and found no marked_video callouts. Those predictions ignored evidence the lane already had. The miss is disclosed, so this is not misreporting.

Wrong guidance: the intake_exists refusal message (scripts/take_intake.py:1379) and SKILL.md lines 20 and 45 tell the operator to use 'an explicit new --family' to start another intake of the same source. resolve_family (take_intake.py:411) refuses that case with source_already_registered. I confirmed this by calling resolve_family directly with a prior_intake registry entry: the new --family returned source_already_registered. In practice only a fresh --state-root works. The message and skill text should be corrected.

Overclaim in the implementation summary: it says run 'refuses a source inside the repository'. check_source (take_intake.py ~249-288) accepts a git-ignored path inside the repository and refuses only tracked or unignored ones. That matches the DoD's 'repo-tracked path' but not the summary's wording.

plan is not strictly read-only. admissibility_check (take_intake.py ~451-486) creates the state-root directories and a .scratch/row-*/split.json, then deletes them. A crash between creation and cleanup would leave them behind. The plan JSON's 'writes' field and SKILL.md disclose this, but the tool draft (program/tool-drafts/take_intake.json:87) says 'writes nothing'.

Running the gated e2e test overwrites the tracked receipt docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/take_intake-e2e.json (tests/test_take_intake.py:732). Any rerun would replace the sealed result. It should write only to the ignored lane directory.

Minor claim-class issues: UNKNOWNS['capture_interval_setup_override'] is classed 'measured' (take_intake.py:106), but it records an operator assertion. The packet's flags_triage block is claim_class 'inferred' (take_intake.py:1667), while the claims list classes 'flags triage denominators' as 'measured'. phrase_anchor_adopted, xoruby_delivery and default_adoption have class None.
Minor: phrase_timing is always invoked with --run-kind real_take (take_intake.py:576), even when --origin is synthetic_fixture. The packet's measurements.master_loudness has no class field.

Known limitation, disclosed as D2 in the handoff: arrangement_markers.py hard-codes program/demo-arrangement.json. For a new take with its own arrangement reference, arrangement_markers fails, and marked_compact plus the arrangement branch are not exercised end to end. The marked_video to share_export branch is also not exercised end to end, because marked_video failed on the fixture. The operator's first run on the real second take will be the first real exercise of these branches.
